text:
Predicates:
Pets(x) ::: x is a pet.
ManagedBuilding(x) ::: x is a managed building.
DepositRequired(y) ::: a deposit y is required to rent an apartment.
Deposit(y) ::: y is a deposit.
EqualOrMore(y, z) ::: y is equal to or more than z.
Fluffy(x) ::: x is Fluffy.
Cat(x) ::: x is a cat.
Rent(x, y) ::: x will rent an apartment in building y.
AllowedPets(y) ::: pets are allowed in building y.
MonthlyRent(y) ::: y is the monthly rent.
SecurityDeposit(x) ::: x is the security deposit.
RentInBuilding(x, y) ::: x rents an apartment in building y.
Tom(x) ::: x is Tom.
OliveGarden(x) ::: x is the Olive Garden.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
Price(y) ::: y is a price.
GreaterThan(y, z) ::: y is greater than z.
Premises:
Pets(Fluffy) ∧ Cat(Fluffy) ::: Fluffy is a cat and a pet.
ManagedBuilding(OliveGarden) ::: The Olive Garden is a managed building.
MonthlyRent(OliveGarden, 2000) ::: The monthly rent at the Olive Garden is $2000.
∃x (Tom(x) ∧ AllowedPets(OliveGarden) ∧ RentInBuilding(x, OliveGarden) ∧ AllowedPets(OliveGarden)) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in The Olive Garden if allowed.
DepositRequired(OliveGarden, y) ∧ Deposit(y) ::: A deposit y is required to rent an apartment in The Olive Garden.
GreaterThan(2000, 1500) ::: 2000 is more than 1500.
Conclusion:
RentInBuilding(Tom, OliveGarden) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in The Olive Garden.
